atr_stop.notes: Virtual ATR stop evaluated on each BloFin scheduler check.

avwap_stop.notes: BloFin supplies a completed-candle AVWAP anchored at the position open when the open strategy has no avwap column.

tiered_tp_atr.notes: The close ref may own sl_atr_mult; otherwise configure strategy-level stop_loss_atr_mult or stop_loss_atr_mult_regime.

tiered_tp_atr_live.notes: TP-only; requires an independent strategy-level ATR stop.

tiered_tp_atr_regime.notes: The close ref may own sl_atr_mult; otherwise configure strategy-level stop_loss_atr_mult or stop_loss_atr_mult_regime.

tiered_tp_atr_live_regime.notes: A unified per-regime close owns its declared per-regime SL; a TP-only close requires a strategy-level ATR stop.

tiered_tp_atr_live_regime_dynamic.notes: Per-regime TP/SL uses persisted scheduler state, a two-cycle regime confirmation by default, and a software-managed virtual stop. BloFin Copy TPSL is not assumed.

tiered_tp_pct.notes: TP-only; requires an independent strategy-level ATR stop.

time_stop.notes: Counts elapsed, completed timeframe bars from the persisted position open time; requires an independent strategy-level ATR stop.

trailing_tp_ratchet.notes: Ratchet progress/high-water/trail are persisted by the scheduler; a breached trail submits a sized market close. No resting Hyperliquid order is assumed.

trailing_tp_ratchet_regime.notes: Requires regime.enabled and trailing_stop_atr_mult_regime; ratchet progress/high-water/trail persist in scheduler state.

zscore_target.notes: Z-score is calculated from the configured lookback of completed candle closes; requires an independent strategy-level ATR stop.
